thread:
Greta Lowe: Quick idea  run a "starter stack" 3-email mini-drip tied to the newsletter spotlight. Short, utility-first: 1) 2-min benchmark clip, 2) quick integration snippet, 3) social proof + CTA to sandbox. Keep each email <80 words. Goal: demo views + sandbox starts.
Ibrahim Khan: Agree. Make the drip modular so we can reuse block for webinar registrants & new signups. Use merge keys: {{segment}}, {{first_name}}, {{cta}}.
Noah Reed: Timing: send at Day 0 (clip), Day 2 (snippet), Day 6 (social proof + poll). For newsletter-clickers send starting at Day 0; for new signups offset by 1 day.
Pri Patel: Subjects to A/B test: stat-led vs how-to-led. Example A: "See how we cut inference cost 30% in 2 min". Example B: "Run your first query in 5 minutes". Run on newsletter cohort.
Greta Lowe: Segments: newsletter_clickers, new_signups_7d, trial_users. CTA mapping: clip -> watch, snippet -> sandbox, social -> book quick demo. Enterprise domains -> immediate SDR alert.
Ibrahim Khan: Tracking keys: utm_campaign=starter_stack_q3, utm_content=slotA|slotB. Instrument event `starter_drip_engaged` with episode number and segment.
Noah Reed: Ops checklist:
```
- Build 3 responsive templates (mobile-first)
- Create segment exports and suppression list
- Add UTM macros and webhook for watch events
- QA staging send to 100 internal (desktop + mobile)
- Set ramp: 1% -> 10% -> full over 72h if metrics healthy
```
Pri Patel: Deliverability notes: keep payload <120KB, inline small SVG thumbnails (<15KB), plain-text fallback. Avoid attachments. Poll in footer (1-click) to capture preference [Cost|Latency|Integrations].
Greta Lowe: I'll draft copy and subject variants by tomorrow noon. @scheduler-bot please queue a dry-run to staging next Wed 09:00 PT.
scheduler-bot: Dry-run scheduled for 2025-03-12 09:00 PT to staging-marketing. Reminder 20m prior.
Ibrahim Khan: After dry-run we'll check opens, clicks, watch webhook. If A variant wins by >3% open lift we'll standardize subject. Also enable enterprise fast-path on any click from mapped domains.
Noah Reed: I'll push templates and run inbox previews Friday. Pri will set segments and webhooks. Greta will finalize copy. We'll sync post dry-run and decide ramp. :rocket:
